summary: The read-only baseline probe reproduced an author-owned post edit loss: submitting a whitespace-only title with a meaningful changed body was rejected as title_and_body_required, and the open editor rerendered the saved title/body, losing the changed body. Rejected save left storage and runtime receipts unchanged; explicit corrected submission succeeded; cancel closed edit mode without changing saved data. This is evidence of a source defect, not an accepted reusable implementation. Probe scope does not establish reply-edit or browser-native behavior.
